capabilities: Save Codex Desktop tasks as Markdown notes
Copy conversation images into the attachments folder
Link tasks into a Dataview daily track by creation date
Update only a managed region so user text is kept
disambiguation: Not a daily journal; it archives AI conversations and only optionally links them into a Dataview daily track.
extras: WorkBuddy support is marked experimental and its local file format has no stability promise; Windows support is listed as hardware validation in progress; data.json stores task IDs and note paths and should be treated as personal data.
motivation: The author wanted AI conversations that produce plans, debugging conclusions and drafts to be filed into the knowledge base instead of being lost under the next conversation.
problem: Plans, debugging conclusions and drafts worked out with an AI get buried under the next conversation, with no automatic way to keep them in the vault.

relations.evidence: optionally link each task into a Dataview daily track by its creation date
Save your local WorkBuddy conversations as notes too

summary: Syncs local Codex Desktop tasks, and optionally WorkBuddy conversations, into Markdown notes with question-and-answer callouts and images.
